programme.title: mareTV: Wismar Bay - World Heritage and Water Paradise
programme.desc: The Wismar Bay is unique in its diversity on the Mecklenburg Baltic Sea coast: cliffs, sandy beaches, salt marshes, enchanted islands and, last but not least, the proud Hanseatic city of Wismar with its brick Gothic buildings, which are a UNESCO World Heritage Site. When the mighty logs get wedged together in the timber mill in the port of Wismar, Steven Buchholz has to get to work with his chainsaw. It's a dangerous job, because the logs weigh tons. As a trained carpenter, Steven is a virtuoso with the chain saw. Even after his shift is over, he is looking for the thrill: the wind off his home island of Poel is favorable that day and he wants to reclaim the German record in the kite surfing high jump. For a long time, Ramona Stelzer only knew fish as a tasty ingredient between two halves of a bun. But when the goldsmith got her hands on fish leather, her business idea was born: she processes the unique natural product fish skin into fine jewelry. The problem is that hardly anyone in Germany tans fish skin. In order to reliably obtain supplies, Ramona now wants to learn this craft herself.

programme.title: Iceland - On Top of the World
programme.desc: A scenic expedition through majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, powerful waterfalls, threatening fjords and almighty glaciers. Hardly any other country offers such a variety of spectacular forces of nature! We will give you an insight on how it can be that the people of a small, distant island with only a fraction of sunlight in some months are happier than the people in more sun-blessed countries.

programme.title: Bavaria's Alpine Kingdom
programme.desc: There are sparkling palaces from ice and snow, like those found in a fairytale. The icy castles are the phenomenal work of Mother Nature but man had a hand in the magnificent stone castles of the region. The spectacular and histrionic mountains of the Bavarian Alps challenge wildlife and the people who live there and the rocky ramparts of this mountain kingdom are built of limestone and fossil rocks that tell of its origins beneath the sea. Millions of visitors from all over the world come to Bavaria every year to witness the mysticism of the landscape. Kings and Queens, tourist and locals, all are welcomed in the fantastic alpine kingdom. Early summer often comes with the threat of storms that bring floods that scour the land and threaten many creatures. But farmers risk these dangers to take their herds to the highest pastures, where they can graze on the sweetest flower-filled meadows. And later from the high-quality milk produced by their herds, the famers make highly prized cheese. Humankind lives among eagle owls, chamoix, wild cats, stoats and ravens up in these mountains.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: Madeira - Portugal's autonomous island in the Atlantic Ocean, is closer to the African coast than to the mother country Portugal, from which it is separated by about 900 kilometers. The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The "Parque Natural da Ria Formosa" is one of the largest lagoon conservation areas in Europe. Bordered by five natural islands. A mosaic of sandbanks, brackish and freshwater lagoons and salt marshes. In 2010, the "Ria Formosa" was chosen as one of the seven natural wonders of Portugal. It is a unique ecosystem: in the winter months, more than 20,000 birds gather here. In addition, the nature park has one of the largest seahorse populations internationally. More than half of all fish species in the Atlantic are said to spawn in the lagoon.

programme.title: Northern Woods
programme.desc: It is a musical film a a tributeto the Nordic forest: it shows its development from a primeval wood to a cultivated forest. Once populated by wild animals such as wolves, bears, eagles, deer and musk oxen, complex re-enactment-scenes shot by dollies and helicopters vividly depict the colonization of the forest by the Celts and Germans. But as time progressed, the northern forest has on numerous occasions fallen victim to environmental degradation and overexploitation. Several provisions were made to protect this wild beauty. The Helsinki resolution of 1993, which stipulated that the woods be used in a way and in a magnitude which guarantees their biological variety and productiveness and vitality, is but one measure put in place to secure the preservation of the natural gem. Time-lapse photography and breath-taking shots show our main protagonist – the woods – in its stunning glory. This beautiful wooded land, changes throughout the seasons. Our woodland is a world-renowned ecological jewel. It is famous, well-known and loved by tourists, forest economists, environmentalists, historians and intellectuals alike.

programme.title: Germany's Mystic Forest
programme.desc: 2.000 rivers and streams dig deep into the underground and transport their water into reservoirs or "Germany's Wild Amazon", the Wupper. These forests and rivers, together with heathlands and moors, are home to a diverse fauna. Martens, badgers, wild boars, hares, roe deer, and red deer, even black grouse and hazel deer find shelter in these parts. Wolves also have a dominant presence, not to mention those who live underground, such as lizards, bats, and snakes. Accompany us on a journey where we explore every corner of this rugged land. Climb underground into the Bergisches Land, through the vast hidden cave systems that sprawl far beneath the forests. There is also much to be discovered in the water, dive with us in crystal clear streams and rivers with their diverse flora and fauna.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: Bavarian Forest - Deep, Dark and Enchanted
programme.desc: After an unusual mass reproduction of bark beetles in the nineties, thousands hectares of old spruce forest were destroyed. Soon after, a new, healthier forest started to grow – a new primeval forest. Within a few years, in place of the former monoculture, a diverse forest developed, rich in spruces, ashes, beech and fir trees. Naturally, this diversity has in turn attracted new animal and plant species. Even lynx and otters returned and made Bavaria their home again.

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: It is one of the wildest roads in Asia: the Trans Sulawesi Highway. The adventurous road leads through Indonesia's fourth-largest island and takes people to spectacular destinations. To beautiful beaches, turbulent cities, or unique primeval forests.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In the extreme north-east of Norway known as the Finnmark region, winters are freezing cold and snowy. Due to the location on the Arctic Ocean, the roads are prone to snow drifts. Every metre is a challenge and a journey into risk. An adventure for all those who set off into the fascinating and unique landscape, through a seemingly endless desert of snow.

programme.title: mareTV: Corsica - Fascinating Mountain World in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Corsica looks like an alpine landscape in the Mediterranean, an island with dramatic rock formations, romantic bays and proud inhabitants who see themselves first and foremost as Corsicans and only then as French. The Greeks in ancient times called the island Kalliste: the beautiful. We explore this fascinating mountain world in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Soomaa National Park is one of Europes wettest wilderness areas. Floods, forests and wetlands create a landscape where canoes replace roads during the fifth season.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Gauja National Park in Latvia features diverse wildlife, red sandstone cliffs and a winding river that flows through forests shaped by long human history.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: The Secret World of Herbs - In the Alps
programme.desc: Secluded for many centuries in inaccessible valleys, the inhabitants of the Alps had no alternative but to rely on the healing powers of nature. A knowledge of herbs was deeply rooted in these mountain-dwellers’ everyday lives – until the twentieth century, when this wisdom became eclipsed by modern academic medicine. Today, Alpine herbs are witnessing a revival, as public interest in regional natural treasures grows. The potential of Alpine herbs is far from exhausted. In the Berchtesgaden Alps, the film shows Hubsi Ilsanker at work as a root-digger, a back-breaking job that has scarcely changed in four hundred years. Authorized by a special historic permit to supply the oldest gentian distillery in Germany, Hubsi digs for protected gentian roots in Berchtesgaden National Park. For yellow gentian is one of the most bitter medicinal herbs in the world, well suited for schnapps and as a general tonic.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: The Secret world of Herbs - In the Balkans
programme.desc: In the pristine nature and mild climate of southeastern Europe grows a unique diversity of wild plants. Far removed from major industry and polluted soils, the Balkan countries have become the largest exporter of herbs in Europe. In Bulgaria alone, more than 300,000 people work with domestic plants. The business is becoming increasingly lucrative. The film takes us to the Croatian coast. On the Adriatic island of Cres, the audience meets Mladen Dragoslavić. In May, when the sage begins to blossom, this beekeeper has one month to produce his income for an entire year – always with the goal of creating the best sage honey in the Balkans. Given a choice, the bees would never choose sage, for entering and exiting the narrow blossom is strenuous. Within three weeks, maximum, Mladen must remove his bees from the island. Otherwise they will die of exhaustion. In Skopje, the capital of Macedonia, the film visits Iva Yosifova. Hollyhock provides the raw material for her objects of art. The herb is medically beneficial, due to its mucilage, which is added to many cough tea mixtures. Iva, though, makes paper from hollyhock. Thanks to the herb’s long fibres, the paper can be spread onto objects and modeled. The technique produces delicate sculptures, as fragile as nature.

programme.title: Stories of the Mediterranean Forest: Sierra Morena
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Basin is one of the planet’s most biologically rich and complex regions. The crossroads of Europe, Asia and Africa is considered to be one of Earth’s biodiversity hotspots. A vast number of both animal and plant species unique to the region live in its various habitats. The Mediterranean Basin is located in one of the planet’s temperate zones. The subtropical climate makes it colder and wet here in winter, hot and dry in summer and mild and rainy in autumn and spring.

programme.title: Fertile Floods - Croatia's Wetlands
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Europe's Wild River - The Elbe - 1.000 Miles of Wildlife and Nature
programme.desc: The river rises in the Czech Giant Mountains. Here it is called the Labe. After Děčín it flows into Germany and is called Elbe. There are various explanations for the origin of the river name "Elbe". One often mentioned is the Latin name of the river "albia", which means "bright water". This would also explain why the stream is referred to with the feminine article "the Elbe", since the Latin term "albia" is also feminine. Rather poetic than linguistically probable, however, is the explanation that elves (Middle High German: alb) scurrying around the pines in the white river mists could have helped the river to get its name. Geographically, the river can be divided into different sections: The Upper Elbe is the part from the source to about Riesa in the administrative district of Dresden, which is more characterized by mountains. The Middle Elbe, on the other hand, is a lowland river. It reaches as far as the Geesthacht dam just outside Hamburg. The Lower Elbe is called the tidal part of the river. Here, the Elbe forms an estuary, a so-called estuary. At high tide, seawater enters this funnel-shaped delta at the mouth of the Elbe and mixes with the freshwater of the river. At low tide, the water then flows off to the North Sea. Finally, the continuation of the estuary funnel in the Wadden Sea is called the Outer Elbe.

programme.title: Masai Mara: The Big Hunt
programme.desc: When food supply in the Serengeti dwindles, the Masai Mara is a paradise for predators. As the black wildebeests, gazelles, zebras and antelopes make their yearly trip from the south of the Serengeti to the north, nature’s best laid trap, the Mara River in Kenya is waiting ahead. Captivating shots filmed under water show how crocodiles prepare for the Big Hunt while other predators lurk on the banks awaiting their bounty. The biggest problems for the migratory animals are the Mara and the Tarek River, where they have to put their lives at risk to get to the other side. A great number of them die as they jump into the river and break their legs, while others are carried away by the drift or drown. Those who are not victims of the river itself risk falling prey to the crocodiles. We entered this unchartered territory, the crocodile domain by heading under water. Follow these predators in and around their habitat and watch prides of lions map out their game plan. In slow-motion, we show you the final showdown between predator and prey. Will it be a successful hunt or will the hoofed animals persevere?

programme.title: Magical Moors
programme.desc: Wide open heaths, windswept and barren in winter, are transformed into wonderful carpets of white, fluffy cotton grass in summer. Large bears and wolves roam alongside delicately fluttering butterflies, the bubbling calls of black grouse and the enchanting trills of the great snipe. Moors, bogs and wetlands can be found all over in Europe. Everyone has at least heard about this habitat but most know little about it. It is an ancient yet largely unknown set of landscapes that is full of enchanting surprises. On a warm spring day, poisonous adders emerge from hiding to perform their impressive mating dance. As dusk falls, snipe gather on traditional leks, leaping and singing to impress the opposite sex. And deep down in the boggy marshes, glittering emeralds of sticky dew lure insects into the deadly arms of meat-eating plants. Magical Moors captures the quiet beauty of a spectacular landscape, and its often elusive wildlife, in stunning detail.

programme.title: Aurora - Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: In the earth’s polar regions, a ghostly flicker and colourful glow often brighten the night sky. Whoever sees an aurora event will never forget this impressive experience. Finland’s Saami people, Alaska’s Inuit, Canada’s Native Americans and New Zealand’s Maori all have legends about the origins and meaning of this magic natural spectacle. These stories tell of spirits dancing in the sky, of a bright and better world where hunting game is abundant, of battling gods and celestial messages.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: The journey leads from the Norwegian Vesterålen to Chad, the Aeolian Islands and the Polish Giant Mountains. As different as the landscapes and cultures may be, all people are united in their love for their children and their desire to give something to tomorrow's generation.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: The journey leads from the Norwegian Vesterålen to Chad, the Aeolian Islands and the Polish Giant Mountains. As different as the landscapes and cultures may be, all people are united in their love for their children and their desire to give something to tomorrow's generation.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: What ideas are people on the 15th meridian east developing to shape the future and leave tomorrow's generations a home worth living in? This consequence leads us to four future designers. From the barren Namib Desert to the glacier worlds of Spitsbergen, Sicily and the Croatian Mediterranean.

programme.title: Gronland - In the Glare of Ice
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: Dust And Stripes
programme.desc: In a never-ending quest for grass and water, the striped herds undertake an annual epic trek across the vast lunar landscape of the Kalahari’s Makgadikgadi Pans. Most of the year, the Makgadikgadi is an inhospitable wasteland of windswept, salt-encrusted pans. For the area’s water-dependent zebra, the Boteti River on the western edge of the pans is a dry-season lifeline. However, it is also a death trap, with lions waiting in ambush and crocodiles lurking in dark riverside caves.

programme.title: Alpine Lakes - Dark Depths and Icy Heights
programme.desc: This is a nature documentary, which leads us into the fascinating world of deep mountain lakes. We conquer ice palaces of unsuspected beauty. In the freezers, in which elves, fairies and mountain trolls once did their mischief, we move, using a special breathing technique and with special cameras in search of nocturnal hunters, whose eyes are equipped with residual light amplifying receptors.

programme.title: Montenegro - From the Black Mountains to the Beach
programme.desc: The Balkan land of Montenegro owes its name to the Black Mountains. But there is so much more: steep cliffs, deep gorges, picturesque lakes, orthodox monasteries, Venetian architecture, sandy beaches and even fjords like those of Norway. There are three climate zones alone in the Adriatic. The inhabitants still try to find their way between the challenges of a post-socialist system, the much-vaunted Balkan remoteness and the opportunities of a still almost completely undiscovered tourist destination in Europe.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.desc: The moon disappears behind the horizon and the stage is set for a new day in the Alps of Berchtesgaden.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.sub-title: Wild Bavaria - In The Shadow of the Watzmann.
programme.desc: Mighty and mysterious, King Watzmann sits above Germany's only alpine national park.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, Florida - The Sunshine State
programme.desc: Nowhere is the American way of life as relaxed as on Florida's beaches. The Keys, a chain of islands at the far southern end of the state, reveal a more laid-back side of the USA. But all of Florida amazes -- with secluded beaches, unspoiled nature, and the legacy of the early European settlers.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, The City and the Sea
programme.desc: The journey up the coast continues through Delaware to suburban New Jersey, and onwards into the heart of Manhattan. In Delaware, famous as a corporate tax haven, we visit a winery. In New York City we zip around with a bicycle courier and then head out to Long Island for oysters.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, The Heart of New England
programme.desc: From New York, the journey up the coast leads into the heart of New England. We visit Yale; spend some time in the 19th century mansions at Newport, RI; tour the coastal fishing and vacation towns of Massachusetts, and then meet a modern entrepreneur in Boston and see her rooftop gardens.

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.sub-title: Wild Baltic - Life on the Amber Coast
programme.desc: The first episode of this two-part nature documentary presents the natural beauty of the shifting sand dunes of the Curonian Spit, the romantic beaches of the Latvian Baltic Sea and the island worlds of Estonia. Time and again, this deserted and almost untouched nature fascinates. In the winter, ringed seals give birth to their young on the pack ice. In the spring, Konik wild horse stallions fight fierce battles amongst themselves, while colourful European rollers fly through the dune forests. Lynxes wander through the coastal forests and in the orchid meadows turncoats and hoopoes find more than enough food. On the islands around Saaremaa in Estonia, grey seals hunt for fish. They share the archipelago with Europe’s largest tern, the Caspian tern.

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.sub-title: Wild Baltic - Enchanted Forests and Moors
programme.desc: The wide, often untouched wilderness of the Baltic hinterland is home to many animals. More than 35 brown bears live in the primeval forests of Alutaguse. In the spring, the Soomaa National Park transforms into a huge lake. Europe's widest waterfall is located in Latvia. In the beginning of May, vimba bream follow the course of the River Venta. The hardly 5-centimetre-long fish have to overcome a 4-metre-long rock barrier in order to reach their spawning grounds.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Halsema Highway, situated on the island Luzon, leads right through the Philippine jungle with its frequent fog and heavy rainfalls. Every trip on this so-called road is an adventure and highly dangerous. We accompany a bus driver and a taxi driver on their challenging trip across the mountains.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Canadian ice roads exist only for a few months in the winter when the ice is thick enough. The only time of the year when goods can be transported up to Northern Manitoba. We accompany the truckers Vlad and Hugh as well as the aboriginal Canadian Scott with his pick-up on their long journey to a village called God’s Lake. A risky trip in icy temperatures, sometimes even below - 60 degrees Celcius. The men are in constant danger of getting stuck and need to forget everything they ever learnt about driving on a highway in order to arrive safely.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: India's state of Rajasthan is known for its ancient palaces, vast landscapes - and wild transport routes. For thousands of years, dromedaries served as the most important means of transport. Today, India's roads are considered fast-paced, chaotic and unpredictable. On a journey through the desert state, we discover its rough roads.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yellowstone National Park is an American national park located in the western United States, largely in the northwest corner of Wyoming and extending into Montana, and Idaho. It was established by the U.S. Congress and signed into law by President Ulysses S. Grant on March 1, 1872. Yellowstone was the first national park in the U.S. and is also widely held to be the first national park in the world. The park is known for its wildlife and its many geothermal features, especially Old Faithful geyser, one of its most popular. While it represents many types of biomes, the subalpine forest is the most abundant. It is part of the South Central Rockies forests ecoregion.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.sub-title: America's National Parks - Great Smoky Mountains
programme.desc: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is an American national park in the southeastern United States, with parts in Tennessee and North Carolina. The park straddles the ridgeline of the Great Smoky Mountains, part of the Blue Ridge Mountains, which are a division of the larger Appalachian Mountain chain. The park contains some of the highest mountains in eastern North America, including Clingmans Dome, Mount Guyot, and Mount Le Conte. The border between the two states runs northeast to southwest through the center of the park. The Appalachian Trail passes through the center of the park on its route from Georgia to Maine. With 12.5 million visitors in 2019, the Great Smoky Mountains National Park is the most visited national park in the United States.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: North America’s National Parks are world famous and their breathtaking landscapes fascinate millions of visitors. This spectacular series will show you what happens beyond the lookouts. Everglades National Park is an American national park that protects the southern twenty percent of the original Everglades in Florida. The park is the largest tropical wilderness in the United States, and the largest wilderness of any kind east of the Mississippi River. An average of one million people visit the park each year. Everglades is the third-largest national park in the contiguous United States after Death Valley and Yellowstone. UNESCO declared the Everglades & Dry Tortugas Biosphere Reserve in 1976, and listed the park as a World Heritage Site in 1979, while the Ramsar Convention included the park on its list of Wetlands of International Importance in 1987. Everglades is one of only three locations in the world to appear on all three lists.

programme.title: Project Antarctica
programme.desc: Why don't you do something sensible? - Tim, Michael and Dennis have heard this sentence more than once since their school days when they professed their dream jobs: Artist, photographer, filmmaker. And they went on to say that some dreams had to remain dreams, that work didn't have to be fun, but above all that it had to pay enough and be safe. A few years later, the three are working on their joint feature film. They put all their eggs in one basket and are determined to invest two years of working time to achieve their goal. Unpaid. It's not just any goal: the three want to travel to Antarctica. They want to find out whether it is possible to reach even the most distant destinations if you only want to. With ten boxes full of equipment, they set off on the 14,000 km journey to Antarctica. And thus on the journey of a lifetime...

programme.title: Darkwoods - Where Nature Survives
programme.desc: Half a century ago the German Duke Carl von Württemberg purchased a 55.000-hectare parcel of land in the Selkirk Mountains in British Columbia, Canada. He baptized his holdings after his native Black Forest, "Darkwoods", and managed the forests in the lonely region sustainably.

programme.title: mareTV: The Caribbean for explorers: St. Vincent and the Grenadines
programme.desc: Much more Caribbean than on the islands of St. Vincent and the Grenadines is hardly possible. Deserted beaches, uninhabited islands, lush vegetation, the 33 islands in total are dreamlike with extremely hospitable inhabitants. Miranda Phillips runs a laundry and water boat on Bequia. Every morning, the 32-year-old navigates from yacht to yacht with her small bright green service vehicle and is already expected by most skippers. Miranda promises radiantly fresh laundry, which she delivers again the same day. And so there is always something going on in her tiny laundrette in the harbour. It turns into a karaoke bar in the evening, because that is Miranda's great passion. Eban Olliver has many jobs at once. He is the lighthouse keeper of Kingstown. And that means a lot of responsibility in St. Vincent's biggest port city. Because Eban doesn't just change the light bulbs, he's a pilot dispatcher, harbour master and guard all in one person. First contact with ships is particularly important. Once he even saved the entire nation from an Ebola virus.

programme.title: mareTV: Martinique
programme.desc: The island of Martinique is a piece of France in the Caribbean, between Florida and South America. And of course, Savoir-vivre applies just as it does on the other side of the Atlantic, between the English Channel and the Mediterranean. Jacky Pascault is the first and only man to cultivate mushrooms in the Caribbean. Everywhere else, they grow on artificially fertilised soil, but Jacky's Champignons Tropicaux flourish on sugar cane fibres. Nicole Vilo tailors hats and dresses out of coconut palms. Of course, the catwalk for the models wearing her first collection is one of the countless dream beaches. The Martiniquais sail on boats they call Yole, which have no keel and are therefore difficult to navigate. The crew members hang over the water in breakneck fashion on long wooden poles. Just the job for Yole-boss Max' "problem kids": they not only learn complicated handling, but also team spirit.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.sub-title: Elephants: Back to the Wild: The Orphanage of Elephants - Nairobi Nationalpark
programme.desc: We follow the rescue of a baby elephant. Once rescued, it will be transported by plane to the breeding station and raised with love and commitment. In order to satisfy the little pachyderm’s urge to move while in the breeding station, there is sometimes an adorable football match between the animals.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.sub-title: Elephants: Back to the Wild: The Return of the Elephants - Tsavo-East-Nationalpark
programme.desc: We accompany the first steps of a two-year-old elephant who is just starting his release program. We also observe the story of two young elephants in their first night in the wilderness on their own. Captivating film footage allows us to truly learn how elephants behave in the wild.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Wild West
programme.desc: Allen and Ton explain their strategies at a storage auction in San Bernardino, win two units, then have a Pepperbox gun and vintage Lionel train set appraised by experts.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Hot Commodity
programme.desc: Allen is late to the auction, leaving Ton to battle a feisty female auction buyer on his own! The guys find a fully functional flamethrower and a rare hand-carved bow and arrow set from South America!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Strat'ed for Cash
programme.desc: On a limited budget in the historic L.A. neighborhood of West Adams, Allen and Ton still win three lockers and find a Maui Blue Fender Stratocaster and a 1930s Schwinn bike.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Viva la Vegas
programme.desc: 1974 death-defying Zig Zag magic sword box, an ultra-rare 1910 poster of the infamous magician Chung Ling Soo, an 1800s naval cane sword and century-old Metlach German beer steins.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Labor of Love
programme.desc: Harley Davidson V-twin EVO engine and revolutionary 1958 dual-suspension swingarm frame; '80s Ms. Pac-Man arcade machine; rare Air Jordan vintage shoe collection in mint condition.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Miami Heat
programme.desc: All-terrain Air Commander Hovercraft, a 1970s NASA countdown clock and a one-of-a-kind 1960s Delta Relay rocket.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ice, Ice, Baby
programme.desc: Ton and Allen have to get aggressive when they encounter a towering opponent with a mountain of cash. The guys uncover a vintage ice resurfacing machine and an Olympic biathlon rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Voodoo Moola
programme.desc: Allen & Ton hit a storage auction in Louisiana's Capitol City and quickly find themselves in trouble with the law! The guys uncover a pair of racing lawnmowers and then stumble on an antique barber chair from the early 1900s!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Got Balls
programme.desc: After returning to LA, Ton & Allen head deep into hostile auction hunter territory and butt heads with a familiar old foe! They discover a driving range golf ball picker vehicle and one of the most accurate rifles ever made!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Big Score
programme.desc: At a climate-controlled storage facility in downtown L.A., Allen and Ton's locker wins score them an antique cash register and a German H&K pistol prized by collectors.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Got a Gun
programme.desc: In the affluent area of Mission Hills, CA, Allen and Ton pick up an estate unit that contains a minibike, a Depression-era slot machine and an 1871 Colt revolver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sidecar Surprise
programme.desc: An unassuming mom in an oversized sweater tries to pull the wool over Ton & Allen's eyes at a storage auction in Arlington, VA. The guys uncover a black powder cannon designed in the 15th century & a Russian military motorcycle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Bowling Pin Payday
programme.desc: Allen & Ton visit Ton's old stompin' ground and go head-to-head with a trash-talking auction buyer. They uncover a 19th century rifle with a matching cutlass bayonet and a mechanical bowling pinsetter from the early 1960's!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Chicago Grand Slam
programme.desc: 1984 Yamaha SS440 Snowmobile that introduced the revolutionary shock absorber suspension; rare autographed 1920s baseball glove; mint Hank Aaron signed baseball; authentic 1950s Robby the Robot collector toy.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Big Easy Money
programme.desc: Allen & Ton head to New Orleans in search of easy money, but instead encounter some bayou bidders with big-time bucks! They discover a pair of early 19th-century dueling pistols & a vintage airboat fitted with a turbine engine!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: High Flying Ton
programme.desc: A nerdy auction buyer tests Ton and Allen's patience at a big container auction in Ventura. The guys discover a basket and burners for a hot air balloon and a 19th century German single shot rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Animal Instincts
programme.desc: The first pump action shotgun - a Winchester Model 1897; a hunter's collection of prize big game, full-body taxidermy.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Fire in the Hole!
programme.desc: 1930s "blasting machine" dynamite detonator box; 1890s treasure chest with secret compartments. Ton smelts jewelry to forge bricks of silver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hula Moola

programme.title: Solsidan - onnea onkimassa
programme.desc: Illallinen. Mickan on voittanut Tareq Taylorin valmistaman illallisen, ja Fredde saa apukokin roolin. Anna on kutsunut ruokaseurakseen hipsterin… vai onko kyseessä sittenkin koditon luuseri? Juuri kun luksusaterian on määrä alkaa, Alexin aineenvaihdunta hiipuu. Ruotsi 2025

programme.title: Käsi sydämellä
programme.desc: Avan mielestä suhde Johniin etenee liian nopeasti, ja hän haluaa ottaa askeleen takaisin. Markus antaa Johnille hyvää tarkoittavia neuvoja. Tukholmalaisella pariterapeutilla Avalla on yliluonnollinen kyky. Laittamalla käden ihmisen sydämelle hän näkee avainhetkiä tämän tulevasta rakkauselämästä. Itse hän on menettänyt uskon rakkauteen, kunnes eräänä päivänä näkee yllättävän näyn. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Pidätä henkeä!
programme.desc: Kenestä pidät eniten?. Kummitusyö jatkuu, mutta nyt uhka alkaa selvitä - ohjaajat tietenkin. Muitakin paljastuksia tehdään. Kuka paljastuu pahiten, ennen kuin yö on ohi? Ruotsalaisessa nuorisosarjassa seuraamme kolmea teiniä, jotka tulevat aivan eri maailmoista ja tapaavat tapahtumarikkaalla kesäleirillä. Ruotsi 2019

programme.title: Agatha Christien Hjerson
programme.desc: Hjersonin ampumisen jälkeen syyllisen jahti kiihtyy. Åkermanin perheen kulissi alkaa rakoilla. Tapauksesta tulee Hjersonille hyvin henkilökohtainen. Moderni ruotsalainen arvoitusdekkari, jonka innoittajina olivat Agatha Christien kertomukset. Ainutlaatuinen murhatutkija Sven Hjerson (Johan Rheborg) muodostaa yllättävän etsiväkaksikon omapäisen tv-tuottajan (Hanna Alström) kanssa. Ruotsi 2021

programme.title: Tervetuloa Sjölyckaniin!
programme.desc: Thomas kosiskelee Lilyä, vaikkei ole vielä eronnut. Trivial Pursuit saa Klaran ja Rillen päättämään rehellisistä väleistä, ja seuraukset ovat veriset. Ruotsalainen komediasarja, johon on helppo samastua. Millaisia ongelmia voi syntyä, kun kolme sukupolvea kokoontuu kesäpaikkaan saaristoon? Ruotsi 2015

programme.title: Happy fucking Pride
programme.desc: “Load More Guys”. Dilan, Ari ja Nina tapaavat yön tapahtumien jälkeen ja joutuvat rajuun riitaan. Dilan yrittää saada Arin luottamaan itseensä mutta valehtelee taas. Tukholma kuplii odotuksia Pride-viikon alkaessa. Treffejä odottava pikkukaupungin poika Dilan, näennäisen itsevarma mutta satutettu huippumeklari Ari ja tämän juuri jätetty kaveri Nina navigoivat vauhdikkaiden kesäpäivien ja kuumien kesäöiden läpi. Ruotsi 2024

programme.title: Opiskelijakämppä
programme.desc: Oliver pakottaa Jennyn siivomaamaan Jörgenin kämpän - muuten hän paljastaa Jennyn salaisuuden. Saga kutsuu Jennyn piknikille, mutta jokin on pielessä. 20-vuotias Jenny jättää Eskilstunan lukeakseen psykologiksi Uppsalassa. Opiskelijakämpässä hän tapaa karismaattiset klubittajat Sagan ja Oliverin, jotka jo ensimmäisenä iltana houkuttelevat Jennyn tekemään päätöksen, jolla on tuhoisat seuraukset... Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Morran ja Tobias
programme.desc: Sarja alkaa. Tobias pääsee vankilasta ja Morran siistii paikat, mutta Tobias kaipaa selliään. Hän lukkiutuu huoneeseensa ja sahaa oveen ruokaluukun. Ruotsalainen komediasarja Morranista ja tämän aikuisesta pojasta Tobiasista, jotka asuvat yhdessä ränsistyneessä talossa. Morran on saanut huomattavan tuen talon saneeraamiseen, mutta alituinen verkossa shoppailu näyttää aina olevan etusijalla. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Hotel Swan Helsinki
programme.desc: Rautala. Jessican puhelin antaa elonmerkkejä. Entä kuka on mystinen turvakamerassa näkyvä hahmo, jonka kanssa Jessica oli tekemisissä katoamisiltanaan? Luksushotellimaailmaan sijoittuvassa kotimaisessa draamasarjassa seurataan hotellijohtoa ja -henkilökuntaa murhatutkinnan keskiössä, jossa kaikilla tuntuu olevan jotain salattavaa. Suomi 2021

programme.title: Sininen enkeli
programme.desc: Irti menneisyydestä, kohti tulevaisuutta. Marko kohtaa tragedian. Kosto elää Puumalassa, Outin mustasukkaisuus nostaa päätään ja isäehdokkaita vierailee sairaalassa. MTV-alkuperäissarja Sininen enkeli kuvaa elävästi 1980-luvun värikästä nousukautta Helsingissä, jossa raha kasvaa puissa, avoautot takaavat vauhdin huuman ja solarium on uusi aurinko. Kaupunkiin saapuu maalaistaustaansa piilotteleva Marko Hyyryläinen, joka haluaa oman osansa rahasta ja rakkaudesta. Ohjelma sisältää syrjivää kielenkäyttöä. Suomi 2021

programme.title: Metsästäjät
programme.desc: Richardsson tekee läpimurron tutkinnassa muttei saa kertoa Erikille. Peter ja Erik yrittävät taas sopia, mutta vahvat tunteet tutkinnasta estävät sen. Ruotsalainen jännitysdraama, jossa Rolf Lassgård esittää omapäistä poliisia Erik Bäckströmiä. Sarja on jatkoa samannimiselle elokuvasarjalle. Ruotsi 2021

programme.title: We Come in Peace
programme.desc: Valtapeliä. Moni seikka viittaa siihen, että taivaalla oleva ilmiö on yhteydessä lapsiin. Olisivatko he avain olentojen ymmärtämiseen? Aktivistien vihamielisyys lisääntyy, ja Moaa uhkaa epäluottamuslause. Ruotsi 2025

programme.title: Bäckström
programme.desc: Erikssonin murha näyttää hankalalta ratkaista, varsinkin kun Bäckström suljetaan pois tutkinnasta ja Ankanin on otettava ohjat käsiinsä. Ruotsalainen rikosdraama perustuu Leif G.W. Perssonin suosittuihin kirjoihin ristiriitaisesta ja omahyväisestä murhatutkijasta Evert Bäckströmistä, joka ratkoo rikoksia omintakeisella tyylillään. Ruotsi 2020

programme.title: The Hunting Party
programme.desc: Tiimi metsästää huumeriippuvaista Nancy Albrightia, joka etsii uutta tapaa päästä pilveen. Ajojahdin lomassa Bexin tiimin on pakko kohdata yllättävä tosiasia, että kaikkiin komentokeskuksessa ei voikaan luottaa. Yhdysvallat 2025

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: James Harper on entinen erikoisjoukkojen sotilas, joka armeijasta erotuksen jälkeen värväytyy puolustusalan yritykseen suorittamaan salaisia operaatioita puolustusministeriölle. Hän saa tehtäväkseen tarkkailla Lähi-idästä kotoisin olevaa tutkijaa Saksassa. Chris Pinen tähdittämä toimintatrilleri on ruotsalaisohjaaja Tarik Salehin (The Nile Hilton Incident) ensimmäinen englanninkielinen elokuva.

programme.title: Beck: Tuhkattu

Rikospaikalle saapuvalle Alexille tapauksesta tulee henkilökohtainen, kun hän tapaa henkilön menneisyydestään. Avuksi rikostutkintaan Alex värvää mentorinsa Martin Beckin.

programme.title: Vingar av glas
programme.desc: Nazli on syntynyt Irakissa ja varttunut Ruotsissa. Hän haluaa sulautua yhteiskuntaan ja kutsuu itseään Saraksi, mikä surettaa hänen isäänsä, joka haluaa hänet naimisiin irakilaisen kanssa. Pian Sara tapaa Johanin, mikä ei helpota tilannetta.

programme.title: Melukylän lapset
programme.desc: Astrid Lindgrenin kirjoihin perustuva ruotsalainen perhe-elokuva. Melukylä on pieni kylä Etelä-Ruotsissa ja siellä sijaitsee kolme tilaa. Välitalossa asuu Liisa ja hänen veljensä Saku ja Naku. Ylätalossa asuvat sisarukset Riitta ja Anna. Alatalossa taas Olli. Niin, ja tietenkin hänen pikkusiskonsa Kersti. Melukylässä eletään ihanaa keskikesää ja joka päivä on täynnä uusia seikkailuja!

programme.title: Paras Ruotsissa
programme.desc: Koko perheen elokuva kiusatusta 11-vuotiaasta Marcellosta, joka haluaa olla paras jossakin. Ystävyydestä luokan uuden tytön kanssa tulee käännekohta.

programme.title: Padelunelmia
programme.desc: Fabian pääsee hyvän padelelämän makuun railakkaissa juhlissa, mutta ensin poikien on kehitettävä osaamistaan vakoilemalla yhtä kilpailijoista. Ruotsalainen komediasarja Fabianista ja Hassesta, jotka päättävät muuttaa sulkkishallinsa padelhalliksi. Vaikkei heillä ole hajuakaan koko hommasta, he satsaavat projektiin lapsen innolla ja täynnä tulevaisuudenuskoa. Ruotsi 2023

Itse hän on menettänyt uskon rakkauteen, kunnes eräänä päivänä näkee yllättävän näyn. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Pidätä henkeä!
programme.desc: Huono tunnelma. Tunnelma on huono Rubenin, Lon ja Wilman välillä. Mikä sopisi paremmin, tai huonommin, kuin lautanrakennuskilpailu? Yksin vesillä voi puhua kaikesta. Ruotsalaisessa nuorisosarjassa seuraamme kolmea teiniä, jotka tulevat aivan eri maailmoista ja tapaavat tapahtumarikkaalla kesäleirillä. Ruotsi 2019

programme.title: Agatha Christien Hjerson
programme.desc: Ravintolassa tehty murha on kopioitu kirjasta, jota ei ole vielä julkaistu. Vain viisi ihmistä tunsi käsikirjoituksen, yhden heistä on oltava murhaaja. Moderni ruotsalainen arvoitusdekkari, jonka innoittajina olivat Agatha Christien kertomukset. Ainutlaatuinen murhatutkija Sven Hjerson (Johan Rheborg) muodostaa yllättävän etsiväkaksikon omapäisen tv-tuottajan (Hanna Alström) kanssa. Ruotsi 2021

programme.title: Tervetuloa Sjölyckaniin!
programme.desc: Klara on kateellinen Thomasin uudesta rakkaudesta. Kun hänen teini-idolinsa muuttaa Sjölyckaniin, hän saa tilaisuuden tehdä Rillen mustasukkaiseksi. Ruotsalainen komediasarja, johon on helppo samastua. Millaisia ongelmia voi syntyä, kun kolme sukupolvea kokoontuu kesäpaikkaan saaristoon? Ruotsi 2015

programme.title: Happy fucking Pride
programme.desc: “Not Today, Satan”. Dilan ja Ari ovat haudanneet sotakirveen. Nina viettää yhä enemmän aikaa Ziggyn kanssa ja päättää erota Saschasta - helpommin sanottu kuin tehty. Tukholma kuplii odotuksia Pride-viikon alkaessa. Treffejä odottava pikkukaupungin poika Dilan, näennäisen itsevarma mutta satutettu huippumeklari Ari ja tämän juuri jätetty kaveri Nina navigoivat vauhdikkaiden kesäpäivien ja kuumien kesäöiden läpi. Ruotsi 2024

programme.title: Opiskelijakämppä
programme.desc: Saga lähtee Jennyn kanssa professori Paulan luo kysymään "varjotentistä". Kočí pyytää Sagaa mukaan Pariisiin. Jenny valehtelee äidilleen Uppsalasta. 20-vuotias Jenny jättää Eskilstunan lukeakseen psykologiksi Uppsalassa. Opiskelijakämpässä hän tapaa karismaattiset klubittajat Sagan ja Oliverin, jotka jo ensimmäisenä iltana houkuttelevat Jennyn tekemään päätöksen, jolla on tuhoisat seuraukset... Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Morran ja Tobias
programme.desc: Tobias saa korvauksen vankilaan unohtamisesta. Morraninkin pitää osallistua jakamalla mainoksia. Autolla se sujuisi, mutta kumpikaan ei osaa ajaa. Ruotsalainen komediasarja Morranista ja tämän aikuisesta pojasta Tobiasista, jotka asuvat yhdessä ränsistyneessä talossa. Morran on saanut huomattavan tuen talon saneeraamiseen, mutta alituinen verkossa shoppailu näyttää aina olevan etusijalla. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Morran ja Tobias
programme.desc: Morranilla on syntymäpäivä. Hän toivoo muuttumisleikkiä ja toiveillallista, kuten TV:ssä. Tobias järjestää molemmat ja laittaa koko homman verkkoon. Ruotsalainen komediasarja Morranista ja tämän aikuisesta pojasta Tobiasista, jotka asuvat yhdessä ränsistyneessä talossa. Morran on saanut huomattavan tuen talon saneeraamiseen, mutta alituinen verkossa shoppailu näyttää aina olevan etusijalla. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Tervetuloa Sjölyckaniin!
programme.desc: Klara ja katastrofiajatukset. Talohuolet saavat Klaran miettimään katastrofeja, ja Mats joutuu rehkimään joka suunnalla. Lily vie Abben tämän elämän ensimmäiselle mustikkaretkelle. Ruotsalainen komediasarja, johon on helppo samastua. Millaisia ongelmia voi syntyä, kun kolme sukupolvea kokoontuu kesäpaikkaan saaristoon? Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Solsidan - onnea onkimassa
programme.desc: Rikkoutunut posliinihiiri nostattaa kauhean hulabaloon Sundbergeillä, ja Alexin on saatettava asiat raiteilleen. Mickan ja Anna pohtivat, onko heistä tullut tylsiä, ja hakevat helpotusta kunnon känneillä. Fredde oppii vihdoin tuntemaan velipuolensa. Ruotsi 2025

programme.title: Käsi sydämellä
programme.desc: Kun Ava ja John kutsutaan pariskuntana juhlimaan Billien neljäkuukautispäivää, on selvää, että John ottaa heidän suhteensa vakavammin kuin Ava. Tukholmalaisella pariterapeutilla Avalla on yliluonnollinen kyky. Laittamalla käden ihmisen sydämelle hän näkee avainhetkiä tämän tulevasta rakkauselämästä. programme.title: Salatut elämät
programme.desc: Black Dahlia. Pihlajakatu 23 B on täynnä naurua, itkua, rakkautta ja suuria salaisuuksia. Perhesarjojen kiistelty ja kiitetty ykkönen jatkaa suuren suomalaisyleisön viihdyttäjänä. Tarinoiden keskiössä ovat Pihlajakadun asukkaat arjen käännekohdissa. Suomi 2026

programme.title: Salatut elämät
programme.desc: Nummi-pusuja. Pihlajakatu 23 B on täynnä naurua, itkua, rakkautta ja suuria salaisuuksia. Perhesarjojen kiistelty ja kiitetty ykkönen jatkaa suuren suomalaisyleisön viihdyttäjänä. Tarinoiden keskiössä ovat Pihlajakadun asukkaat arjen käännekohdissa. Suomi 2026

programme.desc: Jakso 5025 Jyrki! Pihlajakatu 23 B on täynnä naurua, itkua, rakkautta ja suuria salaisuuksia. Perhesarjojen kiistelty ja kiitetty ykkönen jatkaa suuren suomalaisyleisön viihdyttäjänä. Tarinoiden keskiössä ovat Pihlajakadun asukkaat arjen käännekohdissa. Suomi 2026

programme.desc: Jakso 5026 Tyrki! Pihlajakatu 23 B on täynnä naurua, itkua, rakkautta ja suuria salaisuuksia. Perhesarjojen kiistelty ja kiitetty ykkönen jatkaa suuren suomalaisyleisön viihdyttäjänä. Tarinoiden keskiössä ovat Pihlajakadun asukkaat arjen käännekohdissa. Suomi 2026

programme.title: Metsästäjät
programme.desc: Erik uskoo tietävänsä, kuka murhaaja on, mutta Peter kulkee omaa tietään. Odottamaton kuolemantapaus tuhoaa Erikin toiveet ratkaisusta. Ruotsalainen jännitysdraama, jossa Rolf Lassgård esittää omapäistä poliisia Erik Bäckströmiä. Sarja on jatkoa samannimiselle elokuvasarjalle. Ruotsi 2021

programme.title: Sokaistuneet
programme.desc: Q3. Sarja alkaa. Taloustoimittaja Bean työ sotkeentuu yksityiselämään, kun hän rakastuu pankinjohtaja Pederiin ja saa vihjeen tämän pankin ongelmista. Carolina Neurathin todellisuuden innoittamaan romaaniin perustuva jännitysdraama nuoresta toimittajasta, joka ajautuu keskelle valtapelien, rahan ja salaisuuksien maailmaa. Tiivistunnelmaisen sarjan tähtinä Julia Ragnarsson ja Matias Varela. Ruotsi 2018

programme.title: Bäckström
programme.desc: Vanha venäläinen kultainen soittorasia, joka esittää satuhahmo Pinocchiota ja on 300 miljoonan kruunun arvoinen, näyttää olevan murhan motiivi. Ruotsalainen rikosdraama perustuu Leif G.W. Perssonin suosittuihin kirjoihin ristiriitaisesta ja omahyväisestä murhatutkijasta Evert Bäckströmistä, joka ratkoo rikoksia omintakeisella tyylillään. Ruotsi 2020

programme.title: The Hunting Party
programme.desc: Bex tiimeineen jäljittää vankilasta paennutta vaarallista Xander Waxia, jolla on taipumus myrkyttää uhrinsa äkkiarvaamatta. Samaan aikaan komentokeskuksen tiimin sietokyky venytetään äärirajoilleen. Yhdysvallat 2025

programme.title: Shelby Oaks
programme.desc: Riley ystävineen pitää The Paranormal Paranoids -nimistä YouTube-kanavaa, jossa tutkitaan yliluonnollisia mysteerejä. Yhden tutkimusretken aikana hän katoaa jäljettömiin ja muut ryhmän jäsenet löydetään kuolleina. Rileyn sisar Mia kieltäytyy luopumasta etsinnöistä ja suuntaa 12 vuotta myöhemmin hylättyyn Shelby Oaksiin. Kaupunkiin kätkeytyy karmiva salaisuus, jonka olisi pitänyt pysyä haudattuna.

programme.title: Hei me rokataan!
programme.desc: Kaikkien aikojen hauskimmaksi komediaksikin tituleerattu kasariklassikko seuraa kuvitteellista rock-yhtyettä kiertue-elämän ylä- ja alamäissä. Bändiä piinaavat niin vaihtuvat rumpalit kuin laskevat lipunmyynnit sekä raivoisat riidat egojen törmätessä takahuoneiden syövereissä. Oletko valmis vääntämään nupin yhteentoista?

programme.title: Tiedän mitä teit viime kesänä
programme.desc: Eräänä kesäyönä joukko nuoria ajaa vahingossa autollaan kalastajan päälle. Kun he eivät saa häntä elvytettyä, he luulevat tämän kuolleen ja heittävät paniikissa ruumiin mereen. Seuraavana kesänä he alkavat saada outoja kirjeitä, joissa lukee: ”Tiedän, mitä teit viime kesänä.” Pian heitä vainoaa mies sadetakissa ja terävä koukku kädessään. Klassinen 90‑luvun kauhuelokuva.

programme.title: Syyttömänä vankilassa
programme.desc: Conny on kemianopettaja, joka aivan syyttä vedetään huumejuttuun ja tuomitaan vankilaan. Siellä hän oppii tuntemaan ammattirikollisia, jotka hoitavat salaisen tunnelin kautta hämäräbisneksiä. Conny pakotetaan heidän apurikseen.

programme.desc: Sam blir förolämpad när Freddie anklagar henne för att inte betala tillbaka pengarna hon ständigt lånar av honom och Carly. Sam försöker allt hon kan komma på för att kunna betala tillbaka; till och med ett riktigt jobb.

programme.title: iCarly: Aj, Lewbert
programme.desc: En "Driva med Lewbert"-sketch går förskräckligt fel och skadar Carlys oförskämde portvakt. Gänget vårdar honom tills dess att Freddies mamma kommer in och tar över. När en romans börjar spira måste de sätta stopp för den.

programme.title: iCarly: Pajen
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Spencer tar med Freddie till sin favorit-pajställe, får de veta att ägaren har avlidit. Ännu värre; det verkar som om hans recept har gått förlorade för alltid.

programme.title: iCarly: En normal jul
programme.desc: I ett försök att krydda julfirandet med en ovanlig julgran, råkar Spencer av misstag sätta eld på alla Carlys julklappar. Ursinnigt önskar hon att hon hade en normal bror.

programme.title: iCarly: Kyssen
programme.desc: Sam råkar höra när Freddie erkänner för Carly att han aldrig har kysst en tjej , och avslöjar sedan hans hemlighet på webbshowen. Gibby och Carly tränar Spencer inför uttagningen till det lokala proffs-fotbollslaget.

programme.title: iCarly: Vinn en bil
programme.desc: Gänget kör en tävling på iCarly; priset är en ny bil tack vare en lokal bilfirma. Efter att Nevel vunnit, upptäcker ungdomarna att bilfirman inte kände till tävlingen eller gratis-bilen som de påstods ha donerat till tävlingen.

programme.title: iCarly: Sluta Fred
programme.desc: Freddie säger under en sändning att han inte är ett fan av internetsensationen Fred, vilket får Fred att meddela att han tänker sluta att lägga ut filmer för alltid. Fansen blir rasande för att Freddie har orsakat slutet för de populära filmerna.

programme.title: iCarly: Dubbelgångare
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Freddie smiter ut för att se en kampsport-match, skaffar de dubbelgångare för att lura Spencer att de fortfarande är hemma. Under tiden bygger Spencer en gigantisk version av Newtons vagga.

programme.title: iCarly: Rockidolen
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Freddie uppmanar iCarly-fansen att rösta för att David Archuleta ska ta hem segern i "America Sings", tycker de synd om tvåan och hjälper honom göra en musikvideo. Under tiden lär Sam Spencer hur man ljuger som ett proffs.

programme.title: iCarly: Sams Makeover
programme.desc: När Sam erkänner att hon är kär i en kille i skolan, visar Carly hur hon kan locka honom genom att bete sig mer tjejigt. Under tiden blir Spencer övertygad om att en tjej gillar honom på grund av hans smoking, så han börjar ha den på sig hela tiden.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag dejtar en tuffing Del 1
programme.desc: När Carly dejtar en tuffing, försöker hon hålla deras relation hemlig för Spencer. Under tiden betalar Sam Freddie för att göra en hemsida där hon kan lägga ut alla sin favorit-äckel-filmer.

programme.title: iCarly: Återförening med Missy
programme.desc: När Carlys gamla kompis Missy flyttar tillbaks till Seattle, tror Sam att Missy försöker ersätta henne som Carlys bästa kompis.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag måste ha skåpet
programme.desc: När Sam och Freddie båda vinner en tävling för att få det bästa skåpet i skolan, tvingas de dela samma skåp. Under tiden ber Carly Spencer om att han ska ge henne lektioner i bild.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly-galan
programme.desc: Carly, Sam och Freddie ger en iCarly-gala för de bästa användar-bidragen i iCarly, och hyllar pristagarna live i webb-showen. Spencer värvar europeiska baddräktsmodeller för att hjälpa honom att tillverka pris-statyetterna.

programme.title: iCarly: Tvillingar
programme.desc: Freddie försöker bevisa att Melanie, Sams tvillingsyster, bara är Sam som har klätt ut sig. Under tiden, när Carly undervisar Spencers fiende Chuck, försöker Spencer bevisa för Carly att Chuck är ond.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag dejtar en tuffing Del 2
programme.desc: När Carly dejtar en tuffing, försöker hon hålla deras relation hemlig för Spencer. Under tiden betalar Sam Freddie för att göra en hemsida där hon kan lägga ut alla sin favorit-äckel-filmer.

programme.title: iCarly: Kampen mot Dingo
programme.desc: Dingo Channel har uppenbart snott idéer från iCarly, så Carly, Sam, Freddie och Spencer går till Dingos Studio för att säga manusförfattarna ett sanningens ord.

programme.title: iCarly: De kysstes
programme.desc: När Sam av misstag avslöjar för Carly att hon och Freddie i hemlighet har kysst varandra, konfronterar Carly dem båda och undrar varför de aldrig har berättat det för henne. Spencer besöker ett fängelse och håller en konstlektion med fångarna.

programme.title: iCarly: Matfajten
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Freddie besegrar en berömd TV-kock i en matlagningstävling, slutar kocken laga mat, lägger ned sitt matlagningsprogram och vägrar komma ut ur sitt sovrum. Spencer försöker få sin framtidsvision att bli verklighet.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag vill ha min rektor
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Freddie av misstag får rektor Franklin avskedad, tar fröken Briggs och magister Howard kontrollen och inför hårda regler. Under tiden anställer Spencer en gammal rodeostjärna som ska lära honom hur man rider på en mekanisk tjur.

programme.title: iCarly: Snabbdejt
programme.desc: Det kommer så många killar till "Gå ut och dansa med Carly"-tävlingen att Carly, Sam och Freddie måste ha snabb-dejter för att hinna träffa dem alla. Spencer följer ett bisarrt träningsprogram från en ny Pearphone-app.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag fixar till en popstjärna
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Freddie går med på att göra en musikvideo inför en popstjärnas comeback, upptäcker de att popstjärnan är ur form och saknar talang. Under tiden upptäcker Spencer att kvinnan han dejtar är Gibbys mamma.

programme.title: JAG: Need to Know
programme.desc: As a favor from Congresswoman Lillian Dorning, SECNAV Sheffield asks the JAG staff to get the story of a submarine, USS Angel Shark (SSGN-559), which was lost on a CIA mission in 1968.

programme.title: JAG: Friendly Fire
programme.desc: Harm serves as a judge and Mac is the contentious prosecutor in a case fraught withpolitical implications when an American aviator is charged with killing three Britishsoldiers during a flight mission in Afghanistan.

programme.title: JAG: Shifting Sands
programme.desc: When a Gulf War MIA victim is found as the sheik’s wife in a nomadic Arab tribe, Bud prosecutes and Mac defends her against charges of desertion and, in a stunning turn of events, treason. Harm tries to get his old job back but is turned away.

programme.title: JAG: The One That Got Away
programme.desc: Mac defends and Turner prosecutes in the case of a special op marine who, during an Iraqi mission, may have deserted his team for his own survival. Harm takes on a CIA training assignment in a mach six craft that soon has him in danger.

programme.title: JAG: Close Quarters
programme.desc: Back at JAG, Harm is flooded with cases but still wants to help out an 80-year-old veteran accused of robbery. Meanwhile, Turner takes on an assignment in a sub whose crew has rescued possible defecting North Koreans.

programme.title: JAG: Posse Comitatus
programme.desc: Harm and Mac argue the case of a Marine pilot who used force to interfere with a local police matter that led to a man’s killing. Roberts is the investigating officer in the matter of a Navy doctor who is requesting conscientious objector status.

programme.title: JAG: The Boast
programme.desc: When an unwitting corporal boasts to a reporter that he killed an Iraqi prisoner of war, facts begin to emerge that could convict him despite his later claim that he was only lying toi mpress.

programme.title: JAG: Pulse Rate
programme.desc: Harm and Mac go aboard the USS Gillcrist to determine if a seaman’s fatal accident during a routine repair was the result of a co-worker’s dereliction of duty or worse.

programme.title: JAG: Good Intentions
programme.desc: Mac defends a petty officer and former alcoholic accused of a brutal murder after a drinking binge which renders him useless in remembering details that could help him. Roberts is entangled in the case of a Navy Commander accused of embezzling funds.

programme.title: JAG: People vs SECNAV
programme.desc: After an incident in Iraq claims the lives of innocent civilians, SecNav is brought up on charges of war crimes in International Court, and Harm and Mac must defend him. Meanwhile, during a trip to the arcade, little A.J. goes missing.

programme.title: JAG: Hard Time
programme.desc: Mac must accompany a prisoner who once assaulted her across the country while Harm and Bud delve into the case of an HIV-infected fleet officer who, after having his condition revealed and relegated to inactive duty, wants his old job back.

programme.title: JAG: Hard Time

programme.title: Peppermint
programme.desc: Räjähtävä toimintatrilleri Rileysta (Jennifer Garner), joka lähtee eeppiselle koston tielle, kun huumekartelli murhaa hänen miehensä ja tyttärensä.

programme.title: Henkivartijat
programme.desc: Johan Falkin ystävällä Sven Petterssonilla on vaatefirma, joka toimii osittain ulkomailla. Suojautuakseen Viron mafialta hän turvautuu saksalaiseen turvallisuuseksperttiin. Tämä on kuitenkin gangsteri, ja pian Sven on pulassa.

programme.title: The Marksman
programme.desc: Toimintatrillerissä Liam Neeson esittää JIm Hansonia, tilallista ja merivoimien sotaveteraania. Eräänä päivänä hän joutuu mukaan ammuskeluun rajalla ja pelastaa pojan, joka pakenee huumekartellia. Alkaa tappava jahti.

programme.title: Susi
programme.desc: Ruotsalaisdraama erakko Klemensistä, joka huolehtii itsestään Norlannin metsissä ja joutuu konfliktiin Tukholmassa laadittujen lakien kanssa.

programme.title: Star File
programme.desc: Brad Pitt. Viihdeohjelma, jonka jokaisessa osassa piirretään muotokuva jostakin Hollywood-tähdestä, alkutaipaleelta uran huipuille ja suvantoihin. 2020

programme.title: On Set
programme.desc: Viihdeohjelma On Set vie Hollywoodin tähtitehtaan kulissien taakse. 2020

programme.title: Marie Antoinette
programme.desc: Vuonna 1774 Marie Antoinettesta tuli Ranskan kuningatar 19-vuotiaana. Villi elämäntyyli herätti pahaa verta sekä hovissa että kansan keskuudessa. Kirsten Dunst esittää historian skandalööseintä kuningatarta Sofia Coppolan elokuvassa.

programme.title: Second Act
programme.desc: Komedia Mayasta (Jennifer Lopez), joka kyllästyy siihen, ettei saa ylennystä supermarketissa, ja hankkii itselleen pomon paikan tekaistun CV:n avulla.

programme.title: Myös maan päällä
programme.desc: Jatko-osassa yhdelle ruotsalaisen elokuvan suurimmista menestystarinoista tapaamme uudelleen norlantilaisen Ljusåkerin kuoron ja sen lähipiirin.

programme.title: The Imitation Game
programme.desc: Oscarilla palkittu draamatrilleri nerosta nimeltä Alan Turing, joka mursi natsien salaisen koodin toisen maailmansodan aikana.

programme.title: Uusia alkuja
programme.desc: Lämminhenkinen musiikkidraama juuri jätetyn laulaja-lauluntekijän (Keira Knightley) ja rappioituneen levytuottajan (Mark Ruffalo) tapaamisesta.

programme.title: Stieg Larsson: Mies joka leikki tulella
programme.desc: Ruotsalainen dokumenttielokuva Millennium-kirjojen luojasta Stieg Larssonista ja hänen riskialttiista tutkimuksistaan äärioikeistoryhmien parissa.

programme.title: Downton Abbey: Uusi aikakausi
programme.desc: Crawleyn perhe jättää Downton Abbeyn ja lähtee tapahtumarikkaalle matkalle Etelä-Ranskaan selvittämään mysteeriä, joka liittyy leskikreivittären perimään huvilaan. Samaan aikaan elokuvayhtiö vuokraa Downtonin ryhtyäkseen kuvaamaan tähtinäyttelijöillä ryyditettyä elokuvaa, ja tuloilla on tarkoitus korjata kartanon vuotava katto. Suositusta ja ylistetystä sarjasta tehty toinen elokuva.

programme.title: Pikku naisia
programme.desc: Marchin sisarukset Meg, Jo, Beth ja Amy varttuvat äitinsä kanssa 1800‑luvun Uudessa‑Englannissa isän ollessa sisällissodassa. Neljä omapäistä nuorta naista etsii paikkaansa ja elää omilla ehdoillaan. Elämään astuvat Laurie ja John Brooke. Greta Gerwigin ylistetty Alcott-filmatisointi.

programme.title: Sing Street
programme.desc: Musiikkipitoinen draama sijoittuu 1980-luvun Dubliniin, missä nuori Conor joutuu uuteen kouluun ja perustaa rokkibändin.

programme.title: Together
programme.desc: Vuosia yhdessä olleet Tim ja Millie ovat elämänsä käännekohdassa. Kun he muuttavat suurkaupungista maalle uuden alun toivossa, heillä on vain toisensa. Mutta pinnan alla kytevät jännitteet, ja pian he kohtaavat karmivan yliluonnollisen voiman, joka uhkaa tuhota heidän elämänsä, rakkautensa – ja koko olemassaolonsa. Australialaisen body horror -kauhuelokuvan tähtinä ovat Dave Franco ja Alison Brie.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.sub-title: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Moon Shots: Inside the Lost Apollo Archive
programme.desc: The world famous Apollo missions are some of the greatest feats ever accomplished by man. With rare archive footage and unprecedented access to life on board the Apollo spacecrafts, this stunning one-hour special brings scientific history to life.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Rocky Shores / Silent Partner
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: Mars has fired our imagination for thousands of years. The tantilizing possibility of life has made it the most inviting planet in our solar system. It is the only other place that man may one day call home.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface
programme.desc: The interface between Earth and space is the Ionosphere, a region of rarified gas and charged particles. It is very important for radio communications, radar, satellite signals and global positioning. Yet we know so little about it.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Throughout history, our nightly view of the universe has fueled our collective imagination. When it comes to the Big Bang, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the birth of the universe.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 1: The Solar System
programme.desc: This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 7: The Milky Way
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Sun
programme.desc: The sun bathes our planet in warmth and light. It powers the machinery of nature, our weather, and it encourages and sustains life on land and at sea. We study it closely, and it can reveal the secrets of all other stars.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Orbit
programme.desc: Chances are, you are watching this program by satellite, one way or the other. Every day we use these wonders of human design, from communication and weather observation, to GPS and recourse management.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Sling Shot
programme.desc: Soviet Luna 3 was the first to use gravity to change course to photograph the dark side of the Moon. NASA Mariner 10 used the technique to swing by Venus to target Mercury. The gravity sling shot maneuver has become a standard for space navigation.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 3: Asteroids
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 6: Fermi paradox
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: How to Colonize the Stars: The Challenge of Interstellar Flight
programme.desc: Leading physicists and engineers in the field of interstellar travel discuss some of the deep issues we face when considering the problem of sending spacecraft to other stars. Will mankind ever truly become a space fairing civilization?

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hidden Havens: Icy Moons / Icy Gems: Frozen Moons
programme.sub-title: Hidden Havens: Icy Moons / Icy Gems: Frozen Moons
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Fermi Paradox
programme.desc: The Fermi Paradox asks the ultimate question: Given a few reasonable assumptions about the chance of life arising elsewhere in the universe and the distance between the stars, why has an alien civilization not presented itself?

programme.desc: I *Skål for sandheden* møder Rasmus Lindbjerg reality-stjernen Amalie Szigethy og sangerinden Emmelie de Forest til ærlige snakke om kærlighed, musik og royale rygter. Ufiltreret og underholdende.

programme.title: De Entreprenante
programme.desc: TV-kokken Louisa Lorang ser ikke sig selv som iværksætter, men med kogebøger, tv-programmer og stærke samarbejder er hun netop det. Hør hendes inspirerende rejse i De Entreprenante – fuld af vilje, drive og godt humør.

programme.title: Naturligheder
programme.desc: Tre naturnørder elsker edderkopper og deler fascinerende facts om deres natur, zebraedderkoppens hjem og spindets brug. Med biologerne Stine Rasmussen, Bjørli Lehrmann og vandedderkoppen Magda.

programme.title: Skål for sandheden
programme.desc: Rasmus Lindbjerg får besøg af Sarah Grünewald og Jakob Fauerby, der snakker om TV2-programmet Spillet, deres seneste projekter og udfordringer. De leger “Hvornår har du sidst…” og svarer på skålens spørgsmål i en ærlig og underholdende episode.

programme.title: 2 Ristede
programme.desc: To garvede fodboldspillere, Allan O og Dennis Cagara, fortæller om fodboldens bagside – anekdoter, sejre, skuffelser og rå sandheder, både på og uden for banen. Helt uden filter.

programme.title: Riis & Støiholm
programme.desc: I afsnit 14 gæster Allan O og Dennis Cagara, tidligere professionelle fodboldspillere, studiet. Kendt for practical jokes, griner vi af historier om pis, lort, nøgenhed, kys og badekar mellem mænd, fascination af mænds vedhæng og meget mere.

programme.title: 2 Ristede
programme.desc: Allan og Dennis taler med Per Wind – tidligere målmand og træner i FC København, som deler gode fodboldhistorier og kærlighed til sporten og solen.

programme.title: Riis & Støiholm
programme.desc: I afsnit 12 gæster Ralle Pikkefar og Martin Svensson Riis & Støiholm med historier om Cavling-prisen, Superliga-gossip, sorte penge og Robinson. Underholdning med masser af drengerøvsstemning!

programme.title: Endestationen
programme.sub-title: Lig i lasten Speciel: Emil Thorup
programme.desc: Emil Thorup sætter sig ind i rustvognen til en samtale om liv, død – og alt det imellem. Han deler sin kamp mod hudkræft og sin passion for longevity. Med alvor og charme reflekterer han over sundhed, frygt og fremtidens store spørgsmål.

programme.title: Her er dit madliv
programme.sub-title: Her er dit madliv - Season 1 - Episode 015
programme.desc: Simi Jan fortæller om mad i Shaolin-templet, sin pakistanske mors køkken og studietiden i Skotland. Hun har smagt sig gennem det meste af verden – og afslører selvfølgelig også sin guilty pleasure!

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 906

Though it comes during a testy performance review by Parker, Jane agrees to take the pro bono case. When she threatens to file a lawsuit, the principal agrees to raise the girls' concerns with the superintendant. Meanwhile, when bailiff Hank Sullivan is ditched by his mail-order bride, Teri refers him to Grayson. And as Grayson looks to sue the matchmaking service that assured Hank that his $12,000 membership fee was well spent, Jane discovers that her new boyfriend Bill Kendal is seeing other women. While struggling with her feelings about Bill, Jane throws herself into representing Nina and Julia. After Nina's dad insists that she stop the lawsuit, a favorable ruling by the judge prompts the school to cancel the prom. As the case begins attracting a lot of publicity, Jane is blindsided when Parker takes over, and when the judge schedules the trial for the following month, Jane protests that the delay will mean that the girls won't be able to attend their prom. Meanwhile, though Grayson is sure that mail-order bride Irina Nesterenko's courtroom apology has hurt Hank's case, Kim looks to persuade another jilted husband to testify. Because of Jane's tenacity, Principal Duffy agrees to allow the girls to attend the prom as a couple if they will drop their lawsuit. However, when Duffy won't admit other gay couples too, Nina and Julia refuse to accept the principal's offer – with the full support of Nina's dad. Finally, as Jane and Stacy decide to hold their own prom for the girls and their friends, Grayson discovers that Irina conspired with the other man she jilted to rip off Hank. As Kim looks to help Grayson get over being left at the altar, Jane uses the prom she is throwing to break up with Bill.

Meanwhile, Bobbie surprises Jane by going on a dinner date with Parker.
